d:
Chhath mahaparv ke mauke par bihar ke mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri chhath ghat pahunche. mukhyamantri ne chhath ki mahatta, bihar ki lok aastha aur sarkar ki taiyariyon ko lekar kya kaha? dekhie ghat se unka yah khas bayan.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
